items.t: Match Group Keeping AI Out of Dating
items.sum: Match Group is embracing artificial intelligence across its business, but CEO Spencer Rascoff says AI agents won't be allowed to date for users on Tinder, Hinge and its other apps. Rascoff says Match wants its platforms to remain a "human-only zone," even as the company uses AI to verify identities, improve safety and block harmful messages.
